raised: The fee shown is the 2025 average actually charged, which may not be what a new customer would pay
Returns are shown before fees and tax, so the real return is unclear
The '123 מקומי / מחושב / הזנתה' legend is confusing and not explained in words
The 'קיבוץ לפי' (group by) control was unclear until the reader saw the buttons underneath
Track-type names are confusing (מניות vs מניות סחיר vs עוקב מדדי מניות, what סחיר means, what 'גמיש' means)
Rows marked 'חדש' with no fees or returns are useless; hide them or move them to the bottom
The 'חוקים וכללים · 7' button gives no hint of what it shows
An unexplained 0.16% fee on deposits at הפניקס משולב סחיר
The reader doesn't know what מט"ח exposure means; would drop that line
The coloured rings repeat the numbers and add nothing
Small orange clock icons next to almost every number are unexplained and add nothing; would drop them
The '>' arrows on each row have no label saying what they do
The difference between מהחיסכון and מההפקדות fees is never explained
Share exposure of 101% is confusing and worrying
A fee of 'עוד לא דווח' leaves it unclear what will actually be charged; the reader would rather be told than have to click
Exposure differs a lot between tracks of the same type, with no explanation
Missing: tax rules and the benefit for people aged 60 and over
Missing: risk information such as bad years and crash drawdowns
Missing: whether money can be withdrawn at any time, and whether there is a penalty
Missing: whether one can switch tracks or companies later
Missing: the minimum deposit
Missing: 10-year returns
The other product buttons are not needed; would drop them
The fund number column could go into the details

problems.why: The reader names the small orange clock icons beside almost every number as adding nothing and puts them first on the list to remove, which matches the person's complaint that the repeated date-warning marks clutter the table.
